about: One entry per surface id: a recipe that makes a material. Every number is {value, unit, kind, source}; check-presets fails an entry without kind and source. height_recipe names a function in place_kit/surfaces/heights.py (soft large shapes, nothing under about 5 mm). tile_metres is the real size of one picture repeat. uv_method: box (one box mapping in metres), planar (from above), plank (u along the length, v across, random offset per plank). normal_strength is the Normal Map node strength (multiplied by 0.6 where displacement is on). displacement_depth_metres is used only for roles with displace true. Most values are first tries marked judged (from the garden and mine work) or invented; judge by looking. polyhaven names the free Poly Haven scan (CC0) the surface pass downloads and builds the material from (scan_metres is its real size, so one copy of the picture covers that many metres; scan_grain "v" means the grain runs up the picture, so a plank turns it a quarter); a surface with none, or a machine with no network, gets the made-in-code recipe above. absorbent true: the surface soaks water up (earth, straw, cloth, weathered wood), so the wetness layer darkens it but never puts a clear film of water on it. unpaved true: an unpaved ground (earth, mud, gravel, grass, sand, rock): loose stones and pebbles lie on it, and hollows in it hold puddles when the place is damp or wet. scan_colour_pull (a share 0..1, grass only for now): how far the scan's mean colour is pulled toward the palette's mean, keeping the scan's own detail (the scans of grass are dry and olive).
